entities.name: PMID:27494911
observations: 2016 clinical cohort of 77 high-risk rectal carriers of colistin-resistant KPC-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae; 44 received oral aminoglycoside decolonization; followed 180 days.

Propensity-score-adjusted multivariable analysis associated decolonization with lower mortality hazard (HR 0.18, 95% CI 0.06–0.55) and infection hazard (HR 0.14, 95% CI 0.02–0.83). Small nonrandomized study; association does not establish causation.

entities.name: Oral aminoglycoside outcome
observations: In a 77-patient observational cohort, oral aminoglycoside decolonization was associated at 180 days with lower mortality hazard (HR 0.18, 95% CI 0.06–0.55) and KPC-K. pneumoniae infection hazard (HR 0.14, 95% CI 0.02–0.83), adjusted for propensity score.
